basic_info.description: Located on a quiet street in the Bernal Heights, recently remodeled, in ready to move in condition. UPSTAIRS : 2 generous size bedrooms, kitchen with dining area, 1 full bath, lovable living room with fire place  DOWNSTAIRS : 1 bedroom, 1 full bath, lovable living room and 1 car parking garage  Total living area is about 1,350SF and lot is 1,750 SF
